newsitem.title: USA: US OPTIONS FOCUS - Big Liposome spread, ATT busy.
newsitem.headline: US OPTIONS FOCUS - Big Liposome spread, ATT busy.

text.p: An investor long some Liposome Co Inc August 20 calls decided to take some profits and nearly double a position, at the same time moving to the 25 strike and the July expiration, traders said Tuesday.
The Liposome August 20 calls traded nearly 6,600 contracts and the July 25 call traded about 11,100 by afternoon.
"A customer that was long the August 20s sold them at $8 and took a profit," a market maker at the Chicago Board Options Exchange said. "And he bought almost twice as many July 25s at $4."
Liposome shares were up 3/4 at 26-5/8.
Through last Friday, the Liposome July 25 call had open interest of 80 contracts and the August 20 call had open interest of 7,274.

"The customer is still involved," the market maker said. In other trading, AT&T Corp options were fairly busy after the Wall Street Journal reported the company is in merger talks with SBC Communications Inc.
AT&T and SBC declined comment on the report, which said the deal could be worth more than $50 billion.
The AT&T July 40 call, which had open interest of 7,440 contracts through last Friday, when 5,783 contracts were opened, traded nearly 2,200 contracts.
The July 35 call traded about 1,480 contracts. Its open interest was 7,120, which included an addition of 6,998 contracts last Friday. The option rose 1-1/16 to 2-15/16.
The October 40 call also was active, with turnover of about 1,385 contracts. Its open interest was 5,989 and 379 contracts were opened last Friday.
The busiest put was the June 35 with 590 contracts traded.
Activity in SBC Communications options was relatively quiet, with the June 60 call being most active. Turnover in that option was about 220 contracts.
AT&T was up 1-1/4 at 37-3/8 and SBC gained 3/4 to 57-5/8.
Elsewhere, options on several technology stocks drew solid interest as the sector rallied solidly, driving the Nasdaq composite index up more than one percent by afternoon.
The Nasdaq composite index rose 18.15 points to 1,407.87.
Among technology stock options, perennial favorite Intel Corp was active at the American Stock Exchange, led by the June 170 call, which traded 4,715 contracts.
Also, options on shares of U.S. Robotics Corp were fairly busy as that stock moved sharply higher.
The stock gained 4-3/4 to 79-1/2 by afternoon.
Traders said the shares, and those of merger partner 3Com Corp, were up after some analysts said the outlook for networking companies is improving.
"The options have been pretty busy," one market maker in Chicago said of U.S. Robotics options.
"It's been pretty two-way paper with maybe a slight bias toward call buyers," he said.
